title: Bluejay GTS vibrating on high Alert while high alerts are permanently disabled on xDrip.
body:
**xDrip version:** abe5f80-2021.08.18

**Phone:** Xiaomi Mi6 MIUI 11.0.6
**Android Version:** 9 PKQ1. 190118.001
**CGM:** Dexcom G6 (Transmitter 8R####)
**xDrip Core Version:** v2191
**BlueJay Firmware:** 2191

## Issue description:
BlueJay GTS was vibrating for a HIGH BG when BG>300mg/dl but High Alarms on xDrip are disabled. Setting for vibrating watch on alerts when phone is not connected is enabled, but watch was at that time connected to phone. I manually snoozed the alert from xDrip but I got the message "no active alarm" which is normal as my high BG alarms were both deactivated. GTS was still vibrating though as if it had the High alerts hardcoded.

## Expected behavior:
BlueJay GTS should not vibrate on alert when alert is disabled on xDrip.

## Actual behavior:
BlueJay GTS vibrated every 1min when BG was over 300mg/dl and while xDrip high alarms were disabled.

## Steps to reproduce the behavior:

- Connect BlueJay GTS on phone. 

- On phone's xDrip disable high alerts.

- On high BG>300mg/dl BlueJay GTS will start vibrating.
